title: The Survivors
author: rithythul
publicationNote: Working title · Publication date to come
summary: Cambodia's startups from the early days: the ups and downs, and what works and what does not.
homeNote: Some mentors never knew they were teaching.
description: Until the 2000s, Cambodia had mostly traditional companies and NGOs. Startups began in the 2000s and tech startups around 2010, and most of those still running started then.
smallworld has been part of Cambodia's startups since the early days, building startups first-hand and watching others from the sidelines.
It has seen the ups and downs, and founders who started and failed, who go unnamed here.
The book is about what works and what does not, told through the people and the things built, with the lessons from the experiments and from the mentors, whether they know it or not.
